name: openniw
summary: Local companion for the OpenNIW immigration Agent Skills (EB-2 NIW, EB-1A, O-1A, I-485): localhost browser wizard, deterministic USCIS PDF filling, filing-package ZIP, DOCX export, OpenAlex citation harvest, claim-registry linting - all over a case folder on your own machine. No accounts, no database, no API keys, no LLM.
author: OpenNIW contributors
